      infoHow it works
      Type [key] in your document and press Space or Enter — it gets replaced automatically.
      If a key has multiple outputs, a random one is chosen each time.
      Example: key name → outputs Mahi, Rafi — typing [name] inserts either "Mahi" or "Rafi".

      Context Expansion Options

      Scans your enabled sources, then fills the gaps in your selected text round by round — odd word positions first, then even — so the result reads naturally.

      30%

      Higher picks more varied words instead of always the top match.
